eis_specs.document_title: Quorn Park Solar Hybrid — SSD source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.notes: Solar 80 MWac. BESS 20 MW / 40 MWh (2.0h duration). Regime: SSD. SSD-9097 near Parkes NSW; 470 ha in the Central-West Orana REZ. Potentia Energy (formerly Enel Green Power), $192 M, 80 MW PV + 20 MW/40 MWh co-located BESS behind single POC. Panels installed by Beon Energy Solutions; will be first solar-battery hybrid on NEM main grid (energised late 2025, completion late 2026). 132 kV grid connection near Parkes. ~161,000 solar modules installed. 16 x BYD battery units (~27 t each) for the 20 MW / 40 MWh BESS. Beon Energy Solutions EPC.
